gaps.sentence: The bonus made up ___ all the overtime we had done.
gaps.explanation: make up FOR something = compensate for it.

gaps.sentence: It's time you faced up ___ your responsibilities.
gaps.explanation: face up TO something = accept and deal with something difficult.

gaps.sentence: After twenty years of smoking, he finally managed to give it ___.
gaps.explanation: give up = stop/quit (a habit or attempt).

gaps.sentence: These old boots are completely worn ___.
gaps.explanation: wear out = become thin/unusable through use.

gaps.sentence: Don't worry — he always turns ___ late.
gaps.explanation: turn up = arrive, often unexpectedly or late.

gaps.sentence: The plane will drop ___ the parcels at the next farm.
gaps.explanation: drop off = deliver somebody/something; also become less (sales dropped off).

gaps.sentence: I'll pay you ___ as soon as I get paid.
gaps.explanation: pay somebody back = return borrowed money; pay off a debt = finish paying it.

gaps.sentence: Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).
